reuse.why: Uses the existing exported getScheduledAmount helper in shared/schedules.ts, which already covers missing, numeric and ranged values, and routes every ranged-amount site through it.

duplication.why: Removes five inline midpoint copies (schedule-template, forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview) in favour of the one helper.

placement.why: The amount rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the shared layer that both server and preview code import.

scope.why: Limited to the rule, its call sites, helper tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: The expected-amount rule now has a single documented definition used everywhere.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No remaining site computes the ranged amount itself after the change.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; copies were removed rather than reshaped.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, now called by schedule-template.ts, forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts (two sites) and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions.
